sections.note: Run as the administrator of the departed disposable workspace CM-REVIEW-20261026-01 Accept-7 IT (ended in guide 10), so this is the post-departure export repeat. The form refused a short passphrase ('Use a passphrase between 16 and 1024 UTF-8 bytes.') and a mismatched confirmation. A 48-byte random passphrase produced a real browser download: 158,789 bytes, file alga-workspace-e3163e33-....alga-backup, sha256 83aa640b..., with the ALGA-WORKSPACE-ARCHIVE header and no plaintext workspace name in the bytes. The export page reloaded fine. Archive and passphrase are stored privately (mode 600); the passphrase never appears in evidence or arguments. Which contents are included or excluded (MSP-private stores, keys, sessions, credential vault) was not verified, because that needs a restore.

sections.section: 2. Inspect and restore on an isolated destination
sections.note: Done: operator --inspect with the passphrase piped through --passphrase-stdin. It authenticated the archive and returned sourceTenant 0a3c039e..., packageId e3163e33..., a sha256 equal to the downloaded file, and one administrator (Review Accept Admin). Inspect gives no content counts. A wrong passphrase and an archive with one byte flipped were both refused (exit 1, 'failed during archive inspection'). Not done: --restore. The review database is shared with other agents and is not an isolated destination installation, so restore was not run.

sections.section: 3. Activate with the destination's own entitlement
sections.note: Needs a restored destination tenant plus either a Pro licence signed for that tenant or the destination's own verified hosted subscription. None is available.

Boundary only. As the departed customer, Upgrade to AlgaPSA shows 'Your MSP relationship has already ended', 'Paid technician seats required: 1', and 'An active, paid AlgaPSA subscription belonging to this workspace is required before upgrading'. It offers a purchase form (seats, Monthly, Review purchase) with Upgrade workspace disabled. No purchase or conversion was attempted. It needs the customer's own test or paid entitlement. The guide also asks for a separate disposable live relationship, and converting one would end another relationship.

steps: Signed in as the departed disposable workspace administrator; opened Export workspace
Tried a short passphrase (refused), then a mismatched confirmation (refused)
Entered a matching 48-byte passphrase and downloaded the encrypted archive; stored it privately; reloaded the export page
Operator: restore-portable-workspace.ts --inspect --passphrase-stdin on the archive; repeated with a wrong passphrase and with a tampered copy
Opened Upgrade to AlgaPSA and recorded its requirements without purchasing
outcomes: Encrypted archive retained privately: /home/robert/card-review-private/co-managed-it-3363/cm-review-20261026-11-accept7-export.alga (sha256 83aa640bcb938c9e5a3007ab59e1559c08460b0b86eb77b6d8cefab54225bfdb). Passphrase is in cm-review-20261026-11-accept7-export-secret.json (mode 600).
The inspect receipt matches the archive checksum. Wrong-passphrase and tampered archives are refused.
The upgrade screen requires the workspace's own paid subscription. Upgrade workspace stays disabled.
limitations: No restore was run. Proving archive contents, excluded MSP-private data, file links and credential vault recovery is therefore not done.
After the last assertion, the harness's Node process did not exit (probably the download tab); it was killed once recording.json, walkthrough.webm and chapters.vtt were written.
The customer upgrade screen labels its seat field 'Total seats in your pool', which is MSP pool wording. Copy observation only.
missingResources: Isolated destination installation (database-owner operator and file storage) for --restore
Destination entitlement: a tenant-bound signed Pro licence for the restored tenant, or that tenant's own verified hosted subscription
Customer's own paid/test AlgaPSA subscription (or tenant-bound signed licence) and a separate disposable live relationship for the independent upgrade
